strategic_conclusion: On March 12 the war's centre of gravity shifted toward the Gulf's energy system, with Iran's new Supreme Leader calling for the Hormuz blockade to continue, strikes on Bahraini fuel storage and Kuwait's airport, and shipping evacuations from Omani ports, while the Qatar LNG shutdown extended the shock to gas and helium supplies. Iran-aligned forces widened attacks in Lebanon and Iraq, killing a French soldier in Erbil. Outside the region, the ICC opened a Belarus investigation, Nepal's election result became official, Canada announced a major Arctic defence programme, and landslides in southern Ethiopia caused one of the year's deadliest disasters.
